thread:
Ravi Singh: heads up 1: planning a slimroot cutover to replace the current base image. targeting staging window tomorrow 06:30 PT. need RBAC change, KMS sign window, and a quick vuln check.
Samira Gupta: ack. paste RBAC change here so i can verify least-priv. also we'll need the k8s patch annotated with ticket and operator for audit.
Ravi Singh: RBAC delta below 1: we remove cluster-admin from `ci-image-baker` and bind a Role scoped to `infra-builds` that only allows artifact write/read.
```
# RBAC delta
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: ci-image-baker-binding
  namespace: infra-builds
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: ci-image-baker
  namespace: infra-builds
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: image-baker-minimal
```
Maya Lopez: please ensure Role verbs do NOT include `secrets/*` or broad `*` on configmaps. only `get,list,create,update` on `signedartifacts` resource.
Kenji Ito: KMS policy note: signer key must grant `AsymmetricSign` to `ci-baker@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` only, deny `Decrypt` and `Encrypt`. also add a condition restricting signing to resource names that match `slimroot-*`.
Ravi Singh: added `x-audit-id` header in the CI signing step so we can correlate KMS logs with k8s audit. ci snippet: 
```
# example signing request
curl -X POST https://kms.internal/sign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Audit-Id: SEC-1208-slimroot" \
  -d @artifact.sig
```
Samira Gupta: good. add the audit annotation to the k8s patch like `security.ticket=SEC-1208` and `operator=ravi`. we want those in the `objectRef` audit fields.
signing-bot: preflight checklist: [RBAC annotated], [KMS policy review], [X-Audit-Id present], [canary nodes reserved], [seccomp profile uploaded].
Maya Lopez: vuln triage found one failing healthcheck: stripped `/lib/ld-linux.so.2` symlink used by an old probe. low severity but breaks ops monitoring. plan: add a tiny compatibility shim file in the image.
Kenji Ito: prefer image-level shim so runtime matches production. but for faster rollback we can include an init container that restores symlink during rollout.
Ravi Singh: will ship shim in image and keep init workaround ready. Canary will run with `privileged: false`, seccomp profile `slimroot-min.json`, and `capabilities.drop: [ALL]`. also assert `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`.
Samira Gupta: pipeline asserts to add: `securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation == false`, `capabilities.drop contains ALL`, and `securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem == true` where feasible. if any assert fails, block rollout and create rollback PR.
Kenji Ito: i'll run a seccomp fuzz harness and a short eBPF syscall trace on staging nodes during canary and post results here. will flag any unexpected syscall allowed/blocked changes.
Maya Lopez: what is the security rollback path if we see a regression in syscall handling?
Ravi Singh: immediate steps: 1) revoke `AsymmetricSign` on the KMS key to prevent further signing, 2) revert the image tag in the registry to the previous signed image, 3) open an incident runbook and notify oncall sec.
Samira Gupta: and ensure attestations and cosign signatures for the previous image are still valid and accessible; we should preserve attestation records for 90 days.
signing-bot: signing window scheduled: 06:20-06:40 PT. please do not request extra keys outside window.
Kenji Ito: posting initial fuzz run results at 15:00 PT. if anything looks risky, i'll call an immediate pause.
Ravi Singh: thanks all 1: i'll update the cutover ticket with RBAC patch, KMS policy link, and the canary job config. i'll ping channel 15m before staging window. :thumbsup:
